Australia has a mature network of medical device distributors supplying hospitals, clinics, and private practices. Major national providers handle everything from high-tech surgical systems and implants to everyday clinical consumables. [](https://www.device.com.au/)

- [Device Technologies](https://www.device.com.au/): Supplies major hospital divisions including cardiology, critical care, neurosurgery, and orthopedics.

- [ParagonCare](https://paragoncare.com.au/): Distributes medical devices, primary care equipment, and aged-care products across Australia and New Zealand.

- [EBOS Healthcare](https://www.eboshealthcare.com.au/): Operates multiple warehouses nationwide with thousands of active medical and clinical products.

- [Getz Healthcare](https://au.getzhealthcare.com/)

: Focuses on specialized hospital tech, including interventional oncology and neurology solutions.

- [Medical Specialties Australasia](https://msa.com.au/): Specializes in surgical implants, vascular access, and minimally invasive clinical tools.

- [Revolution Surgical](https://www.revolution-surgical.com/): Privately owned distributor providing specialized surgical and medical technologies.

- [LTR Medical](https://www.ltrmedical.com/): Sources and supplies medical and surgical devices for hospitals, practices, and home care.

- [Horten Medical](https://hortenmedical.com.au/distribution-of-medical-equipment/): Delivers specialized surgical innovations and medical equipment to hospitals and day surgeries. [](https://www.device.com.au/)
